summaryZh: Borooah Lab 研究视网膜与黄斑疾病的成因，探索防盲治疗。研究以诱导多能干细胞建模，采用基因治疗、CRISPR 编辑和反义寡核苷酸等策略，并结合成像分析。
researchQuestions: 导致视网膜和黄斑疾病的原因是什么？

evidence.quote: The main aim of our research is to better understand the cause of disease conditions affecting the retina and the main visual part of the retina, the macula.
modelling disease using induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs).
Gene therapy CRISPR gene editing CRISPR DNA base editing PRIME editing Antisense-oligonucleotides
The imaging team uses complex analysis tools and newly developed artificial intelligence algorithms
